```{r }
## verifica se tem o pacote remotes e caso nao tenha instala
if(!"remotes" %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
{
    install.package("remote")
}
## verifica sem tem o odkTreeCensus e desinstala
if("odkTreeCensus" %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
{
    remove.packages("odkTreeCensus")
}
## instala a versao recente do odkTreeCensus

remotes::install_github("adalardo/odkTreeCensus")



```
